objective: Collect a bounded sample of previously recorded conditional-teacher task selections and perform one fixed small GPU BC fit, with no new official games in this stage.
source: Exactly eight previously accepted development traces from mixed baseline, candidate and teacher-task controllers; each source is bound to its historical actor reconstruction and compressed trace SHA. Only decision-time observations and current reservations are used. These are conditional teacher choices in mixed-controller states, not pure teacher trajectories or evidence that those teacher choices were executed.
sampling: SHA256 of compact UTF-8 JSON [game, step, callback ordinal], first 16 bits less than 8192; no label, status, reward or model result influences inclusion. Validate every source turn and callback before accepting the complete collection.
data_limits: Eight complete trace streams once each; at most 128 MiB compressed and 2 GiB decoded input, 16 MiB per line, 4000 selected groups, 250000 selected candidate rows and 8192 candidates per selected group. The candidate limit per group does not apply to unselected callbacks. Require at least 256 selected groups, 32 per training seed and three selected operation kinds before fitting. ZIP_STORED archive and decoded payload at most 128 MiB; immutable snapshot, decoded arrays and copies consume additional RAM, not a hard RAM limit.
collection_supervision: Use a separately verified owned Windows Job; sample summed Job RSS, Job commit, system available memory and wall time. Stop on failure or uncertainty and do not fit. Sampling may exceed thresholds and cannot prove a hard real-time memory cap.
training: At most one fit, fixed training seed, 128 synchronized JAX GPU updates, final update checkpoint only. Validate device identity, finite nonzero gradients and changed parameters; compare 16 groups with CPU using highest requested matrix precision. Labels and seed metadata are not model features; completion status is not used. XLA preallocation disabled does not establish a GPU memory cap.
process_boundaries: WSL Linux session and Windows transport have separate cleanup receipts; the Windows Job synthetic result does not establish WSL or GPU memory supervision. Python and package versions were observed in a local version-only preflight and are rechecked before archive reading. On missing identity, limit, incomplete source, failed receipt, cleanup uncertainty or fit failure, stop and retain partial evidence without retry.
future_evaluation: Reserve two fresh seeds using only recognized seed metadata before reading any trace; freeze the proposed two-seed, round2, both-seat, new-versus-frozen-reference screen and non-regression guardrails. A later separate preregistration is required before the eight games; this small screen cannot demonstrate statistical significance or automatic promotion.
prohibitions: No old held-out records or outcomes used to select data, seeds, model or checkpoint; no new games in this stage, no PPO or DAgger, no default Bot, historical model, official rules or system configuration changes. Publish no model weights, raw traces, features, personal absolute paths, credentials or raw logs.
